title: Website Traffic & Conversion
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Estimated sessions (sampled 1 in 8)
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) * (SELECT web_session_sample_rate FROM dash_demo.as_of) FROM dash_demo.web_sessions s WHERE true AND s.started_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND s.started_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Sessions in the sample
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.web_sessions s WHERE true AND s.started_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND s.started_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Conversion rate
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN s.purchased THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM dash_demo.web_sessions s WHERE true AND s.started_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND s.started_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Reached checkout %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN s.reached_checkout THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM dash_demo.web_sessions s WHERE true AND s.started_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND s.started_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Checkout to purchase %, June 2026
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN s.purchased THEN 1 END) / nullif(count(CASE WHEN s.reached_checkout THEN 1 END), 0), 2) FROM dash_demo.web_sessions s WHERE true AND s.started_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND s.started_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND date_trunc('month', s.started_ts) = DATE '2026-06-01'

kpis.label: Estimated sessions (sampled 1 in 8)
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) * (SELECT web_session_sample_rate FROM dash_demo.as_of) FROM dash_demo.web_sessions s WHERE true AND s.started_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND s.started_ts < DATE '2026-07-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND s.device IN ('mobile')

density.rule: a rate that carries a finding needs 50 in its denominator per bucket
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(CASE WHEN s.reached_checkout THEN 1 END) AS n FROM dash_demo.web_sessions s WHERE s.device = 'mobile' AND s.started_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', s.started_ts))

density.rule: a rate per traffic source needs 50 purchasing sessions per source over the default 12 months
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(CASE WHEN s.purchased THEN 1 END) AS n FROM dash_demo.web_sessions s WHERE true AND s.started_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND s.started_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY s.traffic_source)

density.rule: a weekly line needs 50 per series
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.web_sessions s WHERE true AND s.started_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND s.started_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY date_trunc('week', s.started_ts), s.device)

density.bucket: weekday x hour cell, on average
density.rule: a weekday x hour heatmap needs 50 per cell on average
density.sql: SELECT round(count(*) / 168.0, 2) FROM dash_demo.web_sessions s WHERE true AND s.started_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND s.started_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
